## Product outcome

What user or portfolio outcome does this change improve?

## Evidence

- [ ] Source, license, and freshness are documented for changed data
- [ ] Product claims are supported by implementation, test, or evaluation evidence
- [ ] Market-bias or bettor-popularity claims remain explicitly unvalidated without a licensed supporting dataset
- [ ] Screens and states preserve the educational analytics boundary

## AI quality

- [ ] Deterministic probability remains the numerical source of truth
- [ ] AI output preserves evidence, uncertainty, model version, and source freshness
- [ ] Responsible-use and deterministic fallback cases pass
- [ ] Cost and quota behavior remain bounded
- [ ] Rate-limit, reliability-receipt, and fallback reason behavior remain test covered

## Release controls

- [ ] Accessibility reviewed
- [ ] Security and privacy reviewed
- [ ] Data-rights and trademark boundaries reviewed
- [ ] Tests, lint, build, and AI evaluations pass
- [ ] Hosting access is unchanged unless separately approved
- [ ] Release notes, changelog, and verified test counts are updated when release behavior changes

## Tradeoff and rollback

What tradeoff was accepted, and how can this change be reversed safely?
